#Cumulative GPS score thresholds (%)

#Louvain clustering settings

#Plotting helpers

# Functions
## Loading and scoring
```{r define-functions-scoring}
#Read a count matrix's CSV and standardize gene/cell names
load_dataset <- function(path) {
  counts <- read.csv(path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(counts) <- gsub("-", "_", rownames(counts))
  colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts))
  counts
}

#Run Principal Genes
compute_pg <- function(counts) {
  set.seed(SEED)
  principalgenes(counts, cut = CUT, filters = FILTERS)
}

#Get HVGs
compute_hvg <- function(counts) {
  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(counts))
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- "All_Cells"
  norm_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
  hvg_obj  <- FindVariableFeatures(norm_obj, selection.method = HVG_METHOD,
                                   nfeatures = nrow(counts))
  hvgs <- gsub("-", "_", VariableFeatures(hvg_obj))  # descending order HVGs
  positions  <- match(hvgs, rownames(counts))
  scored_hvg <- hvg_obj[["RNA"]]@meta.data$vf_disp_data_mvp.dispersion[positions]
  names(scored_hvg) <- hvgs
  scored_hvg[is.na(scored_hvg)] <- 0

  list(norm_obj   = norm_obj,
       hvgs       = hvgs,
       scored_hvg = sort(scored_hvg, decreasing = TRUE))
}

#Walk down the ranked Principal Genes and record the gene count at which each cumulative score threshold
select_threshold_genes <- function(top_genes, thresholds) {
  cum_score <- cumsum(top_genes * 100)
  idx <- integer(0)
  t <- 1
  for (i in seq_along(cum_score)) {
    if (cum_score[i] >= thresholds[t]) {
      idx[t] <- i
      t <- t + 1
      if (t > length(thresholds)) break
    }
  }
  if (!length(idx)) stop("No cumulative score threshold was reached")
  if (length(idx) < length(thresholds)) {
    message("Only ", length(idx), " of ", length(thresholds),
            " thresholds reached; highest is ", thresholds[length(idx)], "%")
  }

  list(thresholds = thresholds[seq_along(idx)],
       num_genes  = idx,
       gene_sets  = lapply(idx, function(n) names(top_genes)[seq_len(n)]))
}

#Save the raw counts subset to only top genes
#<EXPORT_DIR>/<name>_<method>_subset_<TOP_N>.csv
save_top_subset <- function(counts, genes, name, method) {
  missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(counts))
  if (length(missing)) {
    warning(name, " ", method, ": ", length(missing),
            " genes not found in counts and left out: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(counts))
  write.csv(counts[genes, , drop = FALSE],
            file.path(EXPORT_DIR, paste0(name, "_", method, "_subset_", TOP_N, ".csv")))
}
```

## Clustering and Calinski-Harabasz
```{r define-functions-clustering}

cluster_and_score <- function(dat, gene_names, resolution = LOUVAIN_RESOLUTION,
                              k.param = KNN_K, seed = SEED) {

  m <- as.matrix(t(log2(dat[gene_names, , drop = FALSE] + 1)))

  #Drop NA columns and all-zero cells
  m <- m[, colSums(is.na(m)) == 0, drop = FALSE]
  m <- m[rowSums(m) != 0, , drop = FALSE]
  m_norm <- m / sqrt(rowSums(m^2))

  # kNN -> snn graph (rann for reproducibility)
  k.param <- min(k.param, nrow(m_norm) - 1)
  graphs <- FindNeighbors(m_norm, k.param = k.param, compute.SNN = TRUE,
                          nn.method = "rann", verbose = FALSE)

  louv <- FindClusters(graphs$snn, resolution = resolution, algorithm = 1,
                       random.seed = seed, verbose = FALSE)
  clusters <- as.integer(louv[[1]])
  names(clusters) <- rownames(louv)  #keep cell names
  clusters <- clusters[rownames(m)]

  n_clust <- length(unique(clusters))
  if (n_clust < 2) {
    warning("Louvain returned a single cluster; Calinski-Harabasz set to NA")
    return(list(clusters = clusters, n_clusters = n_clust, calin = NA))
  }

  list(
    clusters   = clusters,
    n_clusters = n_clust,
    calin      = calinhara(m, clusters)
  )
}

#Cluster on each gene set in a list
cluster_gene_sets <- function(counts, gene_sets, label) {
  lapply(seq_along(gene_sets), function(i) {
    res <- cluster_and_score(counts, gene_sets[[i]])
    message(label, " set ", i, " (", length(gene_sets[[i]]), " genes): ",
            res$n_clusters, " clusters")
    res
  })
}

#Pull one numeric field out of a list of clustering results
pluck_num <- function(res, field) sapply(res, function(r) as.numeric(r[[field]]))

#One row per threshold with Calinski-Harabasz and cluster counts
build_metrics_df <- function(sel, pg, hvg, union, union_sets) {
  data.frame(
    thresholds         = sel$thresholds,
    num_genes          = sel$num_genes,
    union_num_genes    = lengths(union_sets),
    PG_calin           = pluck_num(pg,    "calin"),
    HVG_calin          = pluck_num(hvg,   "calin"),
    PG_HVG_Union_calin = pluck_num(union, "calin"),
    PG_nclust          = pluck_num(pg,    "n_clusters"),
    HVG_nclust         = pluck_num(hvg,   "n_clusters"),
    Union_nclust       = pluck_num(union, "n_clusters")
  )
}
```

## Gene comparison
```{r define-functions-categories}
#Split the top PGs and top HVGs into common/PG-only/HVG-only
build_gene_categories <- function(top_genes, scored_hvg) {
  top_pgs  <- names(head(top_genes, TOP_N))
  top_hvgs <- names(head(scored_hvg, TOP_N))
  common   <- intersect(top_pgs, top_hvgs)
  list(common   = common,
       pg_only  = setdiff(top_pgs, common),
       hvg_only = setdiff(top_hvgs, common))
}
```

## Plotting and saving
```{r define-functions-plots}
#Shared plot theme
base_theme <- function(show_legend = FALSE) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      legend.position             = if (show_legend) "inside" else "none",
      legend.position.inside      = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.justification.inside = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.box.margin           = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.title                = element_blank(),
      legend.background           = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = NA)
    )
}

#Save a plot as TIFF and JPG
save_plot <- function(plot, out_dir, name, suffix,
                      width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT) {
  stem <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, "_", suffix))

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".tif"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")

  ggsave(filename = paste0(stem, ".jpg"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}

# Three series across thresholds. num_col is labeled with num_genes (below,
# blue) and union_col with union_num_genes (above, green).
threshold_plot <- function(df, cols, legend_labels, colors, num_col, union_col,
                           y_lab, show_legend = FALSE) {
  long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(cols), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = cols))

  g <- ggplot(long, aes(x = thresholds, y = value, color = metric)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_text(data = filter(long, metric == num_col), aes(label = num_genes),
              color = COL_PG, vjust = 2, size = 3, family = FONT_FAMILY,
              check_overlap = TRUE) +
    geom_text(data = filter(long, metric == union_col), aes(label = union_num_genes),
              color = "darkgreen", vjust = -2, size = 3, family = FONT_FAMILY,
              check_overlap = TRUE) +
    labs(x = "Cumulative Score Threshold (%)", y = y_lab) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = cols,
                       values = setNames(colors, cols),
                       labels = setNames(legend_labels, cols)) +
    base_theme(show_legend)

  # skip the trend line when too few thresholds were reached
  if (nrow(df) >= 4) {
    g <- g + geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x,
                         method.args = list(span = 1, degree = 1, surface = "direct"),
                         se = FALSE)
  }
  g
}

# Scatter with the top LABEL_N genes of each category highlighted and labeled
make_category_scatter <- function(df, x, y, x_lab, y_lab, cats,
                                  show_legend = FALSE, identity_line = FALSE) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(category = case_when(
      gene %in% head(cats$pg_only,  LABEL_N) ~ "PG only",
      gene %in% head(cats$hvg_only, LABEL_N) ~ "HVG only",
      gene %in% head(cats$common,   LABEL_N) ~ "Both PG & HVG",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[x]]), is.finite(.data[[y]]))

  highlight_df <- filter(df, !is.na(category))
  other_df     <- filter(df,  is.na(category))

  g <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = other_df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]]),
               color = "grey70", alpha = 0.4, size = 1.6) +
    geom_point(data = highlight_df,
               aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], color = category),
               alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = highlight_df,
      aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], label = gene, color = category),
      size = 8 / .pt, family = FONT_FAMILY, max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) +
    scale_color_manual(
      breaks = c("PG only", "HVG only", "Both PG & HVG"),
      values = c("PG only" = COL_PG, "HVG only" = COL_HVG, "Both PG & HVG" = COL_UNION)
    ) +
    base_theme(show_legend)

  if (identity_line) {
    g <- g + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "red")
  }
  g
}

#violin plot of up to VIOLIN_N genes; NULL if there are none
make_violin_plot <- function(norm_obj, genes) {
  #Seurat stores features with "-" instead of "_"
  features <- gsub("_", "-", head(genes, VIOLIN_N))
  if (!length(features)) return(NULL)

  VlnPlot(norm_obj, features = features) &
    labs(x = "Identity", y = "Expression Level") &
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
}
```

## Full pipeline for one dataset
```{r define-functions-pipeline}
run_dataset <- function(name, path, show_legend = FALSE) {
  out_dir <- file.path(OUT_ROOT, paste0(name))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  show_and_save <- function(plot, suffix, ...) {
    print(plot)
    save_plot(plot, out_dir, name, suffix, ...)
  }
  out_csv <- function(df, suffix) {
    write.csv(df, file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, "_", suffix, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  }

  #looad and score
  counts     <- load_dataset(path)
  gene_stats <- list(mean = rowMeans(counts, na.rm = TRUE),
                     var  = apply(counts, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE))
  pg_results <- compute_pg(counts)
  hvg        <- compute_hvg(counts)

  #Count matrices subset to each method's top TOP_N genes
  save_top_subset(counts, names(head(pg_results$top_genes, TOP_N)), name, "PG")
  save_top_subset(counts, head(hvg$hvgs, TOP_N),                    name, "HVG")

  show_and_save(make_pca_plot(pg_results, name), "PCA_Plot")

  # gene sets at each cumulative score threshold
  sel        <- select_threshold_genes(pg_results$top_genes, THRESHOLDS)
  hvg_sets   <- lapply(sel$num_genes, function(n) head(hvg$hvgs, n))
  union_sets <- Map(union, sel$gene_sets, hvg_sets)

  #louvain clustering on each gene set
  pg_res    <- cluster_gene_sets(counts, sel$gene_sets, "PG")
  hvg_res   <- cluster_gene_sets(counts, hvg_sets,      "HVG")
  union_res <- cluster_gene_sets(counts, union_sets,    "Union")

  #Calinski-Harabasz across thresholds
  metrics_df <- build_metrics_df(sel, pg_res, hvg_res, union_res, union_sets)
  calin_cols <- c("PG_calin", "HVG_calin", "PG_HVG_Union_calin")
  p <- threshold_plot(metrics_df, calin_cols,
                      c("Principal Genes", "Seurat's HVG", "HVG_PG_Union"),
                      c(COL_PG, COL_HVG, COL_UNION),
                      num_col = calin_cols[1], union_col = calin_cols[3],
                      y_lab = "Calinski-Harabasz Index", show_legend = show_legend)
  show_and_save(p, "PG_HVG_UNION_CalinskiHarabasz")
  out_csv(metrics_df, "Calinski_Harabasz_Score")

  #PG vs HVG gene categories (for mean-variance and violin plots)
  cats <- build_gene_categories(pg_results$top_genes, hvg$scored_hvg)

  mv_df <- data.frame(gene     = rownames(counts),
                      log_mean = log10(gene_stats$mean + 1),
                      log_var  = log10(gene_stats$var  + 1))
  show_and_save(make_category_scatter(mv_df, "log_mean", "log_var",
                                      "log10(Mean Expression + 1)", "log10(Variance + 1)",
                                      cats, show_legend, identity_line = TRUE),
                "PG_HVG_INTERSECT_Log10_mean_variance")

  # Violin plots
  violin_sets <- list(PG_Only          = cats$pg_only,
                      HVG_Only         = cats$hvg_only,
                      PG_HVG_INTERSECT = cats$common)
  for (v in names(violin_sets)) {
    p <- make_violin_plot(hvg$norm_obj, violin_sets[[v]])
    if (is.null(p)) {
      message("No genes for ", v, " violin plot; skipped")
    } else {
      show_and_save(p, paste0(v, "_Violin_Plot"),
                    width = VIOLIN_WIDTH, height = VIOLIN_HEIGHT)
    }
  }
}
```

# Run all datasets
```{r run-all}
#Check all input files exist before starting
input_paths <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, datasets)
missing <- datasets[!file.exists(input_paths)]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Missing input files in ", INPUT_DIR, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}

dir.create(OUT_ROOT,   recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(EXPORT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

status      <- character(0)
all_results <- list()

for (name in names(datasets)) {
  status[name] <- tryCatch({
    all_results[[name]] <- run_dataset(name, file.path(INPUT_DIR, datasets[[name]]),
                                       show_legend = name %in% LEGEND_DATASETS)
    "success"
  }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
}

# Summary
failed <- status[status != "success"]
if (length(failed)) {
  message("Failed datasets:")
  for (n in names(failed)) message("  ", n, ": ", failed[[n]])
} else {
  message("All ", length(status), " datasets completed.")
}
```
